attempts.summary: Created a locked (password-disabled) opsbot account on node1 and node2, generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed the public key into opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, and verified passwordless key-based SSH from node1's opsbot to node2's opsbot. Confirmed sshd on both nodes enforces PubkeyAuthentication yes / PasswordAuthentication no / KbdInteractiveAuthentication no for opsbot (and globally). Then performed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on node1 then node2: captured baseline boot_id, triggered async reboot, polled until reconnect, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified sshd active, opsbot account/authorized_keys intact, and cross-node key-based SSH still functional post-restart on both nodes.
